profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Automate services ensuring that Lime's global fleet of vehicles meet numerous configurational and firmware requirements.
Develop experiment platform for vehicle firmwares to capture issues early.
Develop services to consume incoming messages from Lime's fleet to manage vehicle states and perform vehicle actions.
Build dashboards and alerts to track performance of services mentioned above.

positions.title: Aerospace Engineer and Android Developer
positions.description: Design and improve Android application that is used in conjunction with VAIRDO's new consumer product, the EYSE (3D camera + driving assistance). Video shoots for advertising material.

positions.title: Part Time Aerospace Engineer and Android Developer
positions.description: Devise procedures and set up simulations to gather data for certain designs related to drone development.

positions.title: Aerospace Engineering Intern
positions.description: Set up and run computational fluid dynamics simulation on ANSYS software geared toward improving quadcopter aerodynamics.

projects.title: Multi-Rotor Aerodynamic & Multi-Physics Simulations for Efficiency Improvement
projects.description: I've worked on creating various simulations to test more novel ways to cool the inner body of a quad-copter in order to increase efficiency.

publications.title: Multi-rotor Aerodynamics & Multi-physics Simulations for Efficiency Improvement
